notes: tester.result runs result_conflict (non-Open round, superseded build and, on POST, a submitted result) for GET and again under the round lock for POST, and reads the result through own_result; services.save_result repeats the submitted check and its own tester lookup, so M1 and M4 edit both, and M4 also lets GET build the form for a submitted result (the page already shows 'Status: Submitted' from the state field). ResultForm.clean requires a Fail observation (no database constraint) and ObservationField(max_length=2000) limits it, so M5's message also says 2001. M3 leaves the tester round page's Open-only 'Record result' link in place (navigation, not a guard). M5 also widens the model field and its column in migration 0005 to 2001, together, because the varchar(2000) column would otherwise refuse the save (a 503) and a model-only change would fail the candidate's makemigrations --check test; pytest-django builds the test database from migrations on every run (no --reuse-db), so the migration edit is seen consistently.
